neededFromUser: In your own browser, signed out: open https://www.facebook.com/login/ and save the sign-in page. If the password is asked on a second page, save that one too before typing the password. Note the address of each up to the question mark. Save each as Webpage, Complete (HTML only re-downloads the address and misses a scripted or submitted form). Keep the files outside the repository: they can hold your account name. Import: node scripts/capture-login-page.mjs --id facebook --from-file <file.html>
